answer: Since you financed through Bayline Credit Union, Bayline holds your title until the loan is paid off, and Northwind no longer has it. You'll generally need a payoff letter from your lender showing your account number, the payoff amount (ask for a 15-day payoff), the date it's good through, and where to send payment. If you'd rather not call Bayline, you can sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request the letter for you (allow 2 business days), and you won't need a letter at all if your lender is in our e-payoff network. The help center doesn't say whether Bayline is in that network, so please contact a store to check.
